name: Tasks
job: Everything you have to do, done by you or an agent
intro: Tasks starts as your own private list and grows into the team's projects. Hand any task to your Lemma: it works in a conversation of its own and asks you before anything leaves.
does: A keyboard-first list and a board that drags, private until you share a task.
Marks the tasks an agent could do with what your Lemma already has.
Turns promises you made in mail and meetings into tasks, keeping the sentence.
setup: Just you, or your team too, with a first project. Or look around with a sample list.
With Mail or Meetings there, choose what happens to promises you made: tasks made for you, asked each time, or never.
Choose who can take tasks: your Lemma, and any other agents in it.
